name: hud_ui_text_input_insert_char_at_cursor
description: HudUiTextInput::InsertCharAtCursor inserts one byte at the current cursor when the buffer has room, advances the cursor, and dispatches the OnBufferFull text-input ftable slot when the buffer is full.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiTextInput class/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b44e0 validates inline strlen, full-buffer branch through ftable slot 8 at offset 0x20, otherwise ShiftTextRight(1, cursor), byte store at buffer[cursor], and cursor increment.

Native smoke zhud_text_input_constructor_and_alloc_smoke verifies inserting 'X' into 'abcd' at cursor 2 yields 'abXcd' with cursor 3 and verifies the full-buffer path dispatches the configured slot without writing past capacity.
